_comment_mail: The office Exchange relay. Internal relays usually accept unauthenticated mail from an internal address on port 25; set smtpUser/smtpPassword only if yours demands them.
_comment_public: Uncomment the three below only when BetSend sits behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS. Set host to 127.0.0.1 at the same time so the app cannot be reached without TLS.
